create_Vocab: create a Vocab object from a list of tokens with custom unknown and end-of-sentence tokens
build_encode_tokens: build a list of integer indices by encoding a sequence of tokens with optional end-of-sentence marker
test_decode_ids: test decoding a list of integer indices back into the original token strings
refactor_index_or_unk: refactor the index_or_unk method to return a default index for tokens not in the vocabulary
summarize_Vocab_methods: summarize the Vocab class methods for bidirectional token-to-index and index-to-token mapping
